dedupe_keys.name: predictive global power system mapping outputs

description: This deposit supplies modelled global electricity-grid layers produced by the predictive global power-system mapping research team. The GeoPackage contains estimated distribution lines together with transmission lines derived from OpenStreetMap, distinguished by a source flag. Two GeoTIFF files represent grid-connected settlement targets and estimated low-voltage infrastructure length per cell. Zenodo version 3538890 lists these three files and provides them under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The inspected own metadata does not establish a uniform observation date or grid-cell resolution, and the layers are static outputs, not an operational feed. They can initialize approximate network models and support electrification, capacity and exposure simulations alongside model-gridfinder. A caveat is that the inferred distribution network is an estimate from remote sensing and other public inputs, not a utility-verified asset register. Night-light detection and input-map completeness can affect coverage. The description mentions four outputs, but only three files are listed, so no fourth deliverable is asserted here.
